wd4-trimbelle-zopp.st: Find a Grave (memorial 55432176): Michael Zopp, born 1838 in Germany, died 30 Apr 1912, buried in Trimbelle Cemetery (look only) with his wife Finnia/Fianna (1840-1916). Children: Caroline Engle, Sarah Elizabeth Simon, William, Simon Edward, Theresa Kate Murphy and Mamie. The 1877 Trimbelle plat (Ancestry image) shows "M. Zopp" by sec. 30, matching this pin.
